infoPlist.NSAlarmKitUsageDescription: Self Mirror sets alarms you ask for in your notes, like “Wake me up at 6:30am”.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Self Mirror connects to your WHOOP's heart rate broadcast (or another heart rate monitor) to show your heart rate live.

plugins.calendarPermission: Self Mirror reads when your events start and end to understand how your schedule affects your day.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Self Mirror uses your location to build your Memories: the places where you spent time today.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow “Always” so Self Mirror can notice where you spend time while the app is closed, and turn each day into a memory. Your location history stays on this iPhone.

plugins.motionPermission: Self Mirror uses motion and steps to notice when movement seems to lift your mood.

plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Self Mirror reads your steps, move calories, exercise minutes, workouts and sleep so they appear on your timeline and in your weekly patterns. Nothing leaves your phone.
plugins.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Self Mirror does not write to Health.

plugins.microphonePermission: Self Mirror uses the microphone when you tap the mic to speak a note.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Self Mirror turns what you say into note text, on your device where possible.

plugins.photosPermission: Self Mirror adds the photos you choose to your memories, and attaches screenshots to bugs and ideas on the Dev tab.
plugins.cameraPermission: Self Mirror opens the camera when you tap a memory prompt, so the photo goes straight into that place's memory.

plugins.photosPermission: Self Mirror shows photos you took at places you visited in your memories, reads where a chosen photo was taken, and finds your latest screenshot for bug reports.
